target_moa.text: Talazoparib is a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitor; PARP enzymes (particularly PARP-1 and PARP-2) facilitate DNA repair of single strand breaks, and talazoparib inhibits PARP enzymatic activity and traps PARP on DNA, preventing DNA repair.

citations.quote: Talzenna (talazoparib, BMN 673) is a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitor. PARP enzymes, particularly PARP-1 and PARP-2, are activated by DNA damage and facilitate DNA repair of single strand breaks.
Traps PARP on DNA, preventing alternative methods of DNA repair.
